title: Velvet Earth
description: This luxurious living space is a visual symphony of stone, water, and light. At its heart is a dramatic backlit onyx waterfall installation — a sculptural centerpiece that infuses movement and serenity into the space. The open-plan layout blends contemporary forms with rich natural textures, while bespoke details such as the bronze accents, layered lighting, and curated art pieces elevate the room’s architectural presence.
